intro: With its elegant white and blue hues and charming blue tassels at the corners, this cotton cushion cover blends modern style with a touch of grace, making your space feel effortlessly cosy and chic.

features.title: Comfort wrapped in every thread
features.text: Crafted from 100% cotton, this cushion cover offers exceptional comfort and durability, providing a soft touch that enhances any seating area.

features.title: Timeless design, easy to wear
features.text: Ideal for couches, chairs, or beds, its timeless design complements modern or classic interiors, making it an easy pick for urban living.

features.title: Quality you feel in every stitch
features.text: Meticulously stitched, this cushion cover boasts high-quality craftsmanship that enhances its aesthetic appeal and longevity.

care: Gentle Machine Wash, Do Not Bleach, Tumble Dry Low, Iron If Needed, Do Not Dry clean
name: 16x16 Cotton Square Cushion Cover
